plan.summary:
This PR changes `DEFAULT_MODEL` from `model-6-1` to `model-6-2`.

- `src/models.ts` holds the new default value.
- Two tests change their expected model string to `model-6-2`.
- The tests pass an explicit model, so they do not read `DEFAULT_MODEL` in the excerpts shown.
plan.riskRationale: One constant changes. The effect is any code that reads DEFAULT_MODEL. The test edits only swap literal strings.
plan.storyArc: The PR changes the default model constant. The test edits only update their literal model strings.
